chosen_variant: B — source-aware sepia ink on paper

diagnosis.rootCause: Pale illumination-like foreground palette combined with small/sparse glyph coverage and antialiasing. Not foreground alpha reduction, a wrong theme stylesheet, group opacity, blend mode or an image filter.
diagnosis.internalComputedProbe: Same exact SVG loaded as a same-origin object with matched theme; actual page image/filter/mask/ancestor chain and full screenshots recorded separately.

rasterEvidence.meaning: Mean dark-ink signal on identical paper at fixed desktop scale, not recognition or structural fidelity score.

sourceAwareMapping.negativeSpace: Original gaps between letters and strokes; no invented holes, transparent highlights, glyph deletion or geometry changes.

decisions.A: Direct sepia improves print-like colour but retains weaker facial plane/shadow separation.
decisions.B: Selected after normal-size isolated and full-scene inspection; better source-supported tonal structure.
decisions.optionalForestAdjustment: Not needed and not implemented; scene, mask and attenuation settings fixed.
